quote: the passive egennēthē (was born) with feminine hēs (of whom) admits both the withheld-father and the birth-narration readings
why: The Matthew 1:16 verdict rests on a single-verse grammatical reading of egennēthē with hēs, not on weighing the challenger's beget-pattern chain against the defender's answering chain by footing, which the rule requires once the pressed witnesses are the pressing side's own chain.
